module: Node "AI Follow" (color ai, once_p_duration). Puts a vehicle in "follow" AI mode to follow another vehicle, without intentional contact. Inputs: aiVehId (no value = player vehicle), targetId (defaults to the player vehicle).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class; each instance represents a node in a graph.

workOnce.desc: Sends ai.setMode("follow") then ai.setTargetObjectID(targetId) to the vehicle.
